Fixed. All 95 integration tests, 46 unit tests, assets, and no_duplicate_extensions tests pass.

The change (src/syntax_mapping.rs:271-285): `SyntaxMapping::get_syntax_for` now falls back to matching mappings against the path with ignored suffixes stripped from its file name (recursively, so multiple suffixes like `test.demo.foo.suffix` are handled), instead of returning `None`. This makes `--map-syntax` globs apply to the base name after `--ignored-suffix` is stripped, e.g. `*.demo:YAML` now matches `foo.demo.example`.

Also relaxed `IgnoredSuffixes::strip_suffix` to a generic lifetime (`src/syntax_mapping/ignored_suffixes.rs:47`) so it can be used with locally-borrowed file names.
